name: Dependency Repair Closure Audit Registry
purpose: Audit whether the DEP repair sequence has successfully prevented unresolved RC, symbolic, partial, deceptive, or blocked artifacts from entering theorem-facing or review-facing infrastructure.

closure_audit_targets.name: RC Repair Closure
closure_audit_targets.requirement: All RC entries must be classified as repaired, quarantined, superseded, blocked-persistent, ready-for-simulation, or ready-for-review.

closure_audit_targets.name: Inheritance Firewall Verification
closure_audit_targets.requirement: Blocked, symbolic, partial, deceptive, and quarantined artifacts must not propagate into theorem-facing infrastructure.

closure_audit_targets.name: Admission Gate Verification
closure_audit_targets.requirement: All admitted dependencies must have explicit admission class, allowed targets, and constraints.

closure_audit_targets.name: Failure Geometry Preservation
closure_audit_targets.requirement: All blocked or unstable artifacts must remain linked to failure geometry or quarantine references.

closure_audit_targets.name: LAW034 Global Closure Protection
closure_audit_targets.requirement: No dependency repair outcome may imply global compositional closure.

closure_classes.meaning: Repair sequence closed with no unresolved dependency leakage.
Repair sequence closed, but some artifacts remain quarantined or blocked-persistent.
Some repair entries remain unresolved but are isolated from theorem-facing use.
Dependency leakage or unresolved recursive inheritance remains active.
